![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/3c304ff10a466abe8a7a98342f58d357fec5a46c6971c5dc0b30203bbbb1ec62.png)

The graph of $y={f}^{′}(x),$ the derivative of $f(x),$ is shown above. Given that $f(0)=0,$ which of the following could be the graph of $y=f(x)?$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that critical points of $y=f(x)$ occur when ${f}^{′}(x)=0$ or ${f}^{′}(x)$ does not exist. In our case, there is one critical point: 

$\,$ $x=-0.5$

Also, we have the following: 

- If ${f}^{′}(x)>0$ then $f(x)$ is increasing.

- If ${f}^{′}(x)<0$ then $f(x)$ is decreasing.

We can now summarize the information from the graph in the table below.

| $x$ | $(-\infty ,-0.5)$ | $-0.5$ | $(-0.5,\infty )$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}^{′}$ | $+$ | $0$ | $-$ |
| $f$ | $↗$ | $\text{max}$ | $↘$ |

Let's now sketch the graph of $y=f(x):$

- First, we draw the critical point. Consider the vertical lines $x=-0.5.$ 

- Since we are told that $f(0)=0,$ we can draw that point on the graph.

- Since $f(x)$ is decreasing $↘$ on $(-0.5,\infty ),$ the point at $x=-0.5$ must be higher than the point at $x=0.$

So, we draw it as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/9a90c6cc7702720da4fb2619935ce1f663fe09a1f0827c520371d4dc39881cf5.png)

- Next, we consider the behavior of $y=f(x)$ in the neighborhood of the critical point:

- Since $f(x)$ is increasing $↗$ on $(-\infty ,-0.5)$ and decreasing $↘$ on $(-0.5,\infty )$, the graph of $y=f(x)$ goes down to the left and to the right of $x=-0.5.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/02833ae5c4579ec492812be7bc8e90958108a60cc2f5b7348d4eb6119f667062.png)

- Finally, by connecting and extending the existing parts with a smooth curve, we obtain a possible graph of $y=f(x):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/8ffc84aff1ce37e77b8c0c169a6cb01b9bff7f5f2d27a834ccea251a7d1acbde.png)
